# Button

Text buttons for actions; six variants, three sizes, loading built in.

`Icyre.Button` · Actions

## Use

```jsx
<Icyre.Button>…</Icyre.Button>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="Icyre.Button">…</x-import>
```
